text:
sam: Quick sync 1: postmortem shows several open remediations slipping. Proposing a pilot: closure SLAs (small=2w, medium=4w), daily pulse for P0/P1 until closed, and a tiny closure card template. Thoughts?

jess: +1. Tiny card and visibility channel (#incident-closures). Auto-ticketing would be great.

priya: tiny card fields: owner, due, impact, validation, rollback, blockers. Keep required minimal.

omar: lifecycle states too: triage / in-progress / review / closed. Owners ack in 24h.

sam: draft card:
closure owner: @owner
due: YYYY-MM-DD
priority: P0/P1/P2
signal: link
validation: steps
blocking-deps: list

lia: can infra-bot auto-create tickets from actions? saves manual work.

infra-bot: created INF-4213 and assigned to @omar (automated).

jess: proposed cadence: day0 summary, day1 postmortem draft, day3 action assignment + closure cards, weekly pulse until cleared.

priya: add IC handoff note: 1-line summary, current owners, blockers, next checkpoint. Pin to thread when IC rotates.

omar: I'll add IC handoff checklist to runbook and tag lifecycle states.

jess: I'll wire closure-SLA metrics into ops dashboard: % closed <=14d, mean time to close, % reopened, % without owner >48h.

sam: Pilot plan: run for next 6 incidents using closure card, infra-bot ticketing, and daily 10-min pulse for P0 week. Lia to coordinate.

lia: I can run the pilot, post example card by EOD tomorrow and kick off daily pulses.

sam: I'll PR the closure card into postmortem templates repo and ping here when ready. Revisit after pilot. :eyes:
